body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> IOGEAR displayed a 2-Port DVI KVM solution at CES 2007. By featuring 2-port USB KVM switch as well as DVI input, it enables users to access two computers from a single USB keyboard, monitor and USB mouse and still use other devices like printer or scanner. It can support 1 PC and 1 Mac simultaneously.
